ops.body: Confirmed cause and implementation: privileged 3s fs_usage trace succeeded for actual Go relay82157. It recorded 358 sets of lane database opens and repeated SHM creation/truncation/pwrite during reads (32601 filesystem trace events). Source Desk.Run did not use incident.Store.Held, so every fact read opened and closed SQLite again. Existing incident runner already uses Held; this patch applies that lifecycle to the relay with deferred closure on all exits. No cached values or long-lived read transaction: each read still starts and rolls back its own transaction and sees external commits. Regression test checks 64 unchanged reads preserve SHM mtime and an independent writer update is immediately visible. PR2466, head85830ead63155818cf18439b6e9bd60cdac84631. Hooks passed. Merge/release/install/performance verification still required; not done. Evidence: /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/cost-retro-20261102/lr-relay-fsusage-nov3.log. No protected process signaled or modified.
